cam_resolution.description: Camera resolution must have exactly two non-negative integers representing [width, height].

items.description: Each point must have exactly two non-negative integers representing [x, y] coordinates.

report_interval.description: Minimum seconds before re-reporting the same pallet after a violation (cooldown). Default: 3600s.

first_waiting_window_time.description: Seconds before violation threshold where a track is considered 'near' and triggers batching wait. Default: max(10, violent_count/5).

fps.description: Frames per second of the camera stream, used to convert frame_id to seconds. Default: 25.

max_batch_wait.description: Maximum seconds to wait when batching violations before forcing a report. Default: 90s.

near_grace.description: Extra seconds to wait after the last near-violation track disappears before reporting. Default: 10s.

post_ready_hold.description: One-shot hold (seconds) after the first ready track is detected, to let near-tracks join the batch. Default: 10s.

min_emit_gap.description: Minimum seconds between two consecutive batch reports for this camera. Default: 60s.

dup_guard.description: Seconds during which an identical pallet set signature is suppressed from re-firing. Default: 180s.

evidence_window.description: Seconds of detection history to sample when building evidence for a report. Default: 90s.

max_track_gap.description: Seconds a track can be lost before its floor timer is reset. Default: 15s.

moving_threshold.description: IoU delta threshold between first and last detection to consider a track as moving. Default: 0.1.

same_pallet_iou.description: IoU threshold above which two candidate tracks are considered the same physical pallet (deduplication). Default: 0.95.

side_face_extra.description: Extra violation time (seconds) added for slender bounding boxes (side-face pallets). Default: 20s.
